--- create_property_graph_property_options.sql
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH g NODE TABLES (
  T PROPERTIES (id OPTIONS (synonyms = ['key']), id + 1 AS next_id OPTIONS (description = 'Next identifier')),
  U LABEL Named PROPERTIES (name OPTIONS (description = 'Name'))
)

--- AST
&ast.CreatePropertyGraph{
  Name: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 22,
    NameEnd: 23,
    Name:    "g",
  },
  Content: &ast.PropertyGraphContent{
    NodeTables: &ast.PropertyGraphNodeTables{
      Node:   24,
      Tables: &ast.PropertyGraphElementList{
        Lparen:   36,
        Rparen:   214,
        Elements: []*ast.PropertyGraphElement{
          &ast.PropertyGraphElement{
            Name: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 40,
              NameEnd: 41,
              Name:    "T",
            },
            Properties: &ast.PropertyGraphSingleProperties{
              Properties: &ast.PropertyGraphDerivedPropertyList{
                Properties:        42,
                Rparen:            146,
                DerivedProperties: []*ast.PropertyGraphDerivedProperty{
                  &ast.PropertyGraphDerivedProperty{
                    Expr: &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 54,
                      NameEnd: 56,
                      Name:    "id",
                    },
                    Options: &ast.Options{
                      Options: 57,
                      Rparen:  84,
                      Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
                        &ast.OptionsDef{
                          Name: &ast.Ident{
                            NamePos: 66,
                            NameEnd: 74,
                            Name:    "synonyms",
                          },
                          Value: &ast.ArrayLiteral{
                            Array:  -1,
                            Lbrack: 77,
                            Rbrack: 83,
                            Values: []ast.Expr{
                              &ast.StringLiteral{
                                ValuePos: 78,
                                ValueEnd: 83,
                                Value:    "key",
                              },
                            },
                          },
                        },
                      },
                    },
                  },
                  &ast.PropertyGraphDerivedProperty{
                    Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
                      Op:   "+",
                      Left: &ast.Ident{
                        NamePos: 87,
                        NameEnd: 89,
                        Name:    "id",
                      },
                      Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
                        ValuePos: 92,
                        ValueEnd: 93,
                        Base:     10,
                        Value:    "1",
                      },
                    },
                    Alias: &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 97,
                      NameEnd: 104,
                      Name:    "next_id",
                    },
                    Options: &ast.Options{
                      Options: 105,
                      Rparen:  145,
                      Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
                        &ast.OptionsDef{
                          Name: &ast.Ident{
                            NamePos: 114,
                            NameEnd: 125,
                            Name:    "description",
                          },
                          Value: &ast.StringLiteral{
                            ValuePos: 128,
                            ValueEnd: 145,
                            Value:    "Next identifier",
                          },
                        },
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
          &ast.PropertyGraphElement{
            Name: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 151,
              NameEnd: 152,
              Name:    "U",
            },
            Properties: &ast.PropertyGraphLabelAndPropertiesList{
              LabelAndProperties: []*ast.PropertyGraphLabelAndProperties{
                &ast.PropertyGraphLabelAndProperties{
                  Label: &ast.PropertyGraphElementLabelLabelName{
                    Label: 153,
                    Name:  &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 159,
                      NameEnd: 164,
                      Name:    "Named",
                    },
                  },
                  Properties: &ast.PropertyGraphDerivedPropertyList{
                    Properties:        165,
                    Rparen:            212,
                    DerivedProperties: []*ast.PropertyGraphDerivedProperty{
                      &ast.PropertyGraphDerivedProperty{
                        Expr: &ast.Ident{
                          NamePos: 177,
                          NameEnd: 181,
                          Name:    "name",
                        },
                        Options: &ast.Options{
                          Options: 182,
                          Rparen:  211,
                          Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
                            &ast.OptionsDef{
                              Name: &ast.Ident{
                                NamePos: 191,
                                NameEnd: 202,
                                Name:    "description",
                              },
                              Value: &ast.StringLiteral{
                                ValuePos: 205,
                                ValueEnd: 211,
                                Value:    "Name",
                              },
                            },
                          },
                        },
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH g NODE TABLES (T PROPERTIES (id OPTIONS (synonyms = ["key"]), id + 1 AS next_id OPTIONS (description = "Next identifier")), U LABEL Named PROPERTIES (name OPTIONS (description = "Name")))
